tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est., -2bp from Aug 4's 140bp as US-Iran deal hopes extended the relief tightening) but remains well above the Jun 22-23 compression zone. The relief is building on a genuine diplomatic track - Bessent says a Hormuz deal could come 'today or tomorrow' (CNBC, Aug 4) - but no final agreement is signed and the strait remains physically closed with attacks continuing. Maintain protection at 60-70%; do not reduce on the tactical tightening. Stress (45%): iTraxx returns to 150-180bp if talks stall. Tail (30%): spikes to 200-230bp if strikes resume at scale. Only reduce on a confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF 66.13 EUR/MWh (Yahoo Finance, Aug 25; +1.27%) while JKM $22.00/MMBtu carried (Reuters, Jul 24) - the JKM-TTF spread remains compressed as Iran-Oman corridor talks advance but no reopening is signed. Qatar's force majeure remains extended into mid-September. The long-JKM/short-TTF thesis that relied on Asia's supply-lag premium remains closed; a confirmed reopening would compress both markers, while a collapsed framework would re-widen the spread.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 est., -2bp) - deal-driven relief extends the tightening but the structural thesis remains unproven until a reopening is signed. ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx est. (+0.4%) still green zscore. ASEAN Energy ~116 idx est. (-1.9%) remains deeply depressed vs baseline as Brent fell to $85.74 (Yahoo Finance, Aug 26; -8.57%). Hold the energy underweight; close the banks long only when reopening is confirmed and credit spreads show sustained compression.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)

tradeIdeas.title: Maintain Long USD/PHP and USD/IDR - Pause Is Tactical, Not Structural
tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.5 est. (Aug 5, -0.3%) and USD/IDR ~15,750 est. (-0.2%) softened as corridor hopes lifted EM FX. The relief should not reverse positions - no final deal is signed, Hormuz remains largely shut after a tanker was disabled off Oman, and Brent at $85.74 (Yahoo Finance, Aug 26) remains above pre-crisis levels. Maintain short PHP/IDR (long USD); re-enter long PHP/IDR only on confirmed reopening with sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (maintain short vs USD)
